# The Binary Brain Network (TBN)

> Software division of The Big Brand Network (TBBN), Mumbai. Builds focused,
> offline-first operational software for Indian hospitality and service
> businesses. Every product is a flat annual licence — no monthly SaaS fees,
> no per-seat charges, and the customer's data stays on their own hardware.

Contact: tbn@tbbn.in · +91 88790 70732 (WhatsApp) · https://tbn.tbbn.in

## Products

- [Folio](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/): Room-service ordering and billing for
  hotels that already run a hotel management system but have no module for
  in-room orders. Status: live in production. Windows. ₹6,500 per property per
  year, 7-day free trial. Offline-first, AES-256 encrypted database, hourly
  backups with automatic recovery, GST-compliant bills, per-room tabs, dues with
  aging, bill rectification, automated owner's daily report.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/folio/features/)

- [Pass](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/): Restaurant management and billing. Status:
  in trials. Windows and Linux. ₹7,500 per year flat, covering unlimited outlets
  at current pricing, 30-day free trial. Offline-first, includes a Kitchen
  Display System at no extra cost, station-wise KOT routing, split bill, table
  merge, multi-outlet with separate GSTIN and bill numbering per outlet,
  inventory with recipe deduction, staff and payroll, UPI QR payments.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/features/)

- [Slate](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/): Hotel management system (PMS). Status: in
  trials. Windows, Linux and Android. ₹12,000 per property per year, 14-day free
  trial. Bookings, room board, rate plans, hourly stays, group bookings, guest
  folios, GST invoicing, housekeeping, C-Form for foreign guests, GSTR-1 and
  Tally export, payroll, night audit, manager's day sheet, 12 reports. Unlimited
  devices on the property network at no per-device charge.
  [Full specification](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/features/)

## Answers to common questions

- Pricing is published openly on each product page. It is a flat annual licence
  per property or business, not a monthly subscription, and not per room, per
  seat or per terminal.
- All three products work fully offline. The database lives on the customer's
  own machine. Internet is used only for updates and optional features.
- Installation, onboarding and staff training are included free in every licence.
- Referral: a customer who refers another business that signs up receives a flat
  ₹1,500 credit, applied immediately rather than held until renewal.
- Data export to Excel, PDF and CSV is available in all products. Customer data
  is never held hostage.
- Linux install instructions with exact terminal commands are on the
  [Pass](https://tbn.tbbn.in/pass/#linux) and
  [Slate](https://tbn.tbbn.in/slate/#linux) pages.

## Not yet available (do not present these as shipping)

- Pass: direct Swiggy and Zomato connectivity — the online-order inbox is built,
  but platform connectivity is pending a partnership.
- Slate: channel manager for OTAs including Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo,
  Agoda and Expedia — built, but in testing and partnership approval.
- Slate: owner remote dashboard — built, rolling out shortly.
- Folio: off-site cloud backup, 58mm printer support.
